archetypes.name: dyn-proposal-contract
archetypes.rationale: The change adds thresholded proposal and filing requirements that must remain internally consistent.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the learn-from-bugs proposal contract and its structural pins. Verify the applicable Section 4, 5, and 7 scopes, the 150- and 400-line boundaries, and that the independent estimate prevents self-reported size from disarming a threshold. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
